en.title: DHHS Updates Accessibility Rules, Impacting Healthcare Compliance Nationwide
en.summary: The Department of Health and Human Services revised its accessibility regulations, potentially altering compliance risks for hospitals and providers. Additionally, Kazakh youth are leveraging technology to improve accessibility, while a University of Phoenix survey highlights AI’s role in work and learning access. Other updates include campus accessibility funding and ADA anniversary outdoor expansions.

zh-TW.title: 衛生部更新無障礙規則，影響醫療合規與風險
zh-TW.summary: 衛生及公共服務部已更新無障礙規則，可能提升或降低醫療機構的合規風險。哈薩克青年利用科技開發無障礙應用與設備，鳳凰大學調查則顯示人工智慧在工作與學習中的潛力。此外，國立大學獲補助改善無障礙環境，環保部亦宣布ADA週年戶外設施擴展。
